core: 开始 means to start an action or event. Learners often overuse it for actions that start automatically (like waking up or raining); use it for intentional events, meetings, meals, or plans.

sentences.situation: At a group dinner · to family
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men kāi shǐ chī fàn ba
sentences.why: You say this when everyone is seated and ready to begin a meal. It is a polite, natural way to signal the food is ready.
sentences.tip: Said with a rising tone to sound friendly. Do not say 开始吃吧 without 我们, which sounds like commanding.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ men xiàn zài kāi shǐ kāi huì
sentences.why: You say this when all meeting participants have arrived. It signals the meeting is officially starting.
sentences.tip: Said in a steady tone. If you are the boss, you can say 开始吧 alone.

sentences.pinyin: diàn yǐng yǐ jīng kāi shǐ le
sentences.why: You say this when someone arrives late to watch a movie. It implies they missed the beginning.
sentences.tip: Use 了 to show the start already happened. Do not say 电影开始了吗 if you mean it has started.

sentences.situation: At a gym · to a new friend
sentences.pinyin: wǒ shàng gè yuè kāi shǐ xué yóu yǒng
sentences.en: I started learning to swim last month.
sentences.why: You say this when talking about a new hobby or habit. It tells when the activity began.
sentences.tip: Place time words before 开始. Do not say 我开始学游泳上个月.

sentences.situation: At a shop · to the shopkeeper
sentences.pinyin: nǐ men jǐ diǎn kāi shǐ yíng yè
sentences.why: You ask this when you want to know when a shop opens. 营业 means doing business.
sentences.tip: Said with a rising tone. A shorter version is 几点开门?

sentences.pinyin: huì yì sān diǎn kāi shǐ, duì ma
sentences.en: The meeting starts at 3 o'clock, right?
sentences.why: You say this to check the meeting time with your boss. It is a polite way to confirm a schedule.
sentences.tip: Rising tone on 对吗. Do not say 三点开始了, which means it already started.

sentences.pinyin: nǐ cóng jīn tiān kāi shǐ yào zǎo shuì
sentences.en: Starting today, you need to go to bed early.
sentences.why: You say this to set a new rule or habit for someone. It means the rule starts now and continues.
sentences.tip: 从...开始 is a common pattern. Do not say 从今天开始你要早睡 without 要, which sounds less natural.

sentences.situation: On the phone · to a client
sentences.zh: 我们的合作从下个月开始。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men de hé zuò cóng xià gè yuè kāi shǐ
sentences.why: You say this to confirm the start date of a business project. It sounds official and clear.
sentences.tip: 合作 means cooperation. This is a formal way to state a timeline.

sentences.situation: At a restaurant · complaining to the waiter
sentences.zh: 我们等了半小时，菜怎么还没开始做？
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men děng le bàn xiǎo shí, cài zěn me hái méi kāi shǐ zuò
sentences.en: We waited half an hour, why hasn't the cooking started yet?
sentences.why: You say this when your food takes too long. It is a polite but firm complaint.
sentences.tip: 还没... shows the action still hasn't happened. Do not say 还没开始做吗 if you are complaining.

sentences.situation: At a training event · as an instructor
sentences.zh: 如果大家都准备好了，我们就开始。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ dà jiā dōu zhǔn bèi hǎo le, wǒ men jiù kāi shǐ
sentences.en: If everyone is ready, we'll begin.
sentences.why: You say this before starting a class or workshop. It gives participants a moment to get ready.
sentences.tip: This is a formal, polite way to start an event. 就 means then.

quiz.prompt: You are at home with your family. Everyone is seated and the food is on the table. Say that you will start eating.
quiz.explain: 开始吃饭 is the natural way to signal a meal is ready in a casual setting.

quiz.prompt: You want to ask a shop what time they open in the morning.
quiz.explain: 开始营业 is the standard polite way to ask a shop's opening time.

quiz.prompt: You are telling your new colleague that you started learning Chinese three months ago.
quiz.answer: 我三个月前开始学中文。
accept: 我三个月前开始学汉语。
我从三个月前开始学中文。
quiz.explain: 开始学 + language is the natural way to say you began learning something.

quiz.prompt: You are confirming with your boss that the meeting starts at 2 PM. Use a rising tone to check.
quiz.explain: Adding 对吗 makes it a polite confirmation, not a statement.

quiz.prompt: 朋友问你：“你什么时候开始学汉语的？” 请回答。
accept: 我上个月开始学汉语的。
quiz.explain: Use 开始 + time to answer when an activity began.

quiz.prompt: 你到电影院的时候，电影已经开始十分钟了。你怎么告诉朋友这件事？
quiz.answer: 电影已经开始了，我们错过了开头。
accept: 电影已经开始十分钟了。
我们到的时候电影已经开始了。
quiz.explain: 已经开始了 shows the action already happened, which is the key point when arriving late.
